artworks.title: La Brouette (The Paltry Coach)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two anthropomorphic butterflies transporting a wheeled canopy cart on a naturalistic platform. The drawing features two butterflies with human-like torsos standing on their hind limbs. They are facing each other while holding the handles of the cart, which is centered between them. The cart has wheels and is topped with a canopy under which a small creature can be seen peeking out. The scene rests on a platform resembling a tree branch or ledge adorned with greenery and tendrils. Below this ledge, there are decorative florals and stylized root-like structures, with "LA BROUETTE" inscribed at the bottom of the drawing.

artworks.title: Title Page (Le Titre)
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed irregularly to and within plate mark): 32.2 x 24.5 cm (12 11/16 x 9 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays intricate and swirling lines forming an elongated triangular shape at the center. There are elegantly detailed butterflies scattered throughout. The surrounding area contains delicate, flowing lines reminiscent of plants or vines. At the base, there are cloud-like formations. The central structure is inscribed with text.

artworks.title: Théâtre Italien (Italian Theater)
artworks.description: The image shows an ornate stage with moth-like figures with wings. The stage is intricately decorated with floral and foliage elements arching above to create a canopy effect. In the center, two insect figures with large wings appear to be performing a dance. The wings are detailed with patterns resembling moth or butterfly wings. Surrounding the stage, decorative motifs include leaves, flowers, and scroll-like shapes, suggesting a lush garden. A banner at the bottom reads "THEATRE ITALIEN." The image showcases intricate linework and careful craftsmanship.

artworks.title: Ballet Champêtre (Country Ballet)
artworks.description: This drawing depicts anthropomorphic butterflies dancing under a floral and vine archway. Three butterflies with humanoid features are shown posing gracefully, while another butterfly plays a musical instrument. The archway above them is made of twisted vines and leaves, creating a stage-like setting. The base of the image features organic shapes and patterns around a scroll with the text "Ballet Champêtre." The style is ornate and delicate, typical of the Rococo period.

artworks.title: Le Duel (The Duel)
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 33.1 x 23.7 cm (13 1/16 x 9 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of anthropomorphic butterflies engaged in a duel with fencing swords. The butterflies have human-like bodies with wings resembling cloaks or capes. They stand on an ornate structure featuring decorative architectural elements like columns with floral and leaf motifs. Above them are arches, canopies, and hanging vines, creating a theatrical setting. The drawing combines fantasy and nature elements, showcasing elegance and imagination.

artworks.title: Théâtre Français (French Theater)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a theatrical stage with insect-headed, butterfly-winged figures. The drawing shows an ornate stage setting labeled "THEATRE FRANÇOIS" with intricate architectural and natural elements, such as a large spider web forming the backdrop and vines adorning the space. Two figures, each with human bodies, butterfly wings, and insect heads, are positioned as if performing on a platform bordered by decorative columns. The design is elaborate and displays a blend of fantasy and elegance, typical of Rococo art, with detailed embellishments and a sense of whimsy.

artworks.title: La Toilette
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 33.2 x 23.8 cm (13 1/16 x 9 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of butterfly-like creatures in a surreal setting. The scene features two large butterfly-like figures on ornate furniture, surrounded by elaborate scrollwork. In the background, a small creature with person-like body and insect wings is engaged in an activity. The drawing includes detailed lines and objects like books and furniture with intricate patterns. There is also a sign that reads "LA TOILETTE" at the bottom.

artworks.title: Laban cherchant ses dieux (Laban Searching for his Household Gods)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a gathering of people in a biblical or historical setting. The scene depicts several individuals beneath a tent-like canopy. To the center-left, a woman sits with an infant on her lap, surrounded by other figures in flowing robes. To the right, a figure stands authoritatively, gesturing as if speaking or giving instructions. The detailed etching captures the texture of the fabrics and expressions of the figures, with shading and cross-hatching used to create depth and dimension. The scene is composed with a balance of horizontal and vertical elements, drawing the viewer's eye across the assembly of figures and objects on the ground.

artworks.title: Reconciliation of Absalom and David (Réconciliation d'Absalom et de David)
artworks.medium: etching reworked in graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a scene featuring a regal figure in an ornate interior. The image includes opulent drapery and architectural elements like columns and arches. In the center, a seated figure is wearing a cape that suggests authority. Around them, other figures are interacting, with one figure kneeling in front of the main subject. The figures are depicted with intricate linework, emphasizing the texture and grandeur of the scene. Chiaroscuro is used to highlight the drama and gravity of the moment depicted.

artworks.title: Allegory of the Dauphin's Convalescence (Allegorie sur la convalescence du Dauphin)
artworks.description: This illustration depicts a group of figures in a classical architectural setting, with clouds and mythological figures above. In the foreground, there is a kneeling figure wearing a robe, who appears to be turning towards the celestial beings. Surrounding the main figure are women in classical attire. The upper portion shows ethereal figures on clouds, one holding a staff with a serpent. The background features a detailed classical building. The bottom includes text in French. The style resembles a detailed etching reminiscent of classic historical or allegorical artworks.

artworks.title: Allégorie des Ecoles gratuites du dessein (Allegory of the Free Drawing Schools)
artworks.medium: etching reworked with graphite and black ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a detailed etching of an allegorical scene featuring cherubs and classic architecture. The scene depicts ornate architectural structures with columns in the background, surrounded by playful and dynamic cherubs interacting with each other. Some cherubs are holding wreaths or decorative elements. In the center, there is a draped female figure holding a lyre. The setting suggests themes of music and art, exuding a sense of celebration and grandeur. The drawing style is meticulous and intricate, with elaborate lines and shading creating depth and dimension.

artworks.title: Allegorie sur la mariage du Comte de Provence
artworks.medium: etching, reworked with graphite and brown and black ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical allegorical scene with mythological elements. The image depicts various figures arranged in a mythological setting, with a central draped figure surrounded by other characters, some with wings. Objects such as shields, garlands, and a lion add to the allegorical feel. The background features ornate architectural elements. The shading and intricate details suggest a classical style.

artworks.title: Expulsion of the Jesuits (Expulsion des Jesuites)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of scenes illustrating acts of justice and authority. Two circular scenes are depicted, each in a classical style. On the left, there is a depiction of a book burning with books being tossed into a fire, and two figures participating in the act. The scene is labeled with the text "COMBUSTIS LIBRIS VI die Augusti MDCCLXI". On the right, another circular scene shows a figure holding a large document or proclamation, with two other figures conversing within an architectural setting, labeled "PERVERSIS TANDEM DELETIS SCHOLIS MDCCLXI". Above, there are decorative elements including an all-seeing eye, open books, and garlands. A tablet at the bottom contains an inscription in French discussing decrees and actions taken against certain educational or ideological texts, reflecting themes of censorship and authority. The artwork's intricate border and symmetrical design give it a formal and historical appearance.

artworks.title: Young Woman on the Terrace (La jeune femme a la terrasse)
artworks.dimensions:
image: 7 × 5.8 cm (2 3/4 × 2 5/16 in.)
sheet (trimmed within platemark): 8 × 6.4 cm (3 1/8 × 2 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting in a relaxed position with their head turned slightly to the left. The person's facial features are softly rendered with a gentle expression, and they have curly hair. They are wearing elegant clothing, including a scarf or shawl, with intricate details. The background has textured shading that may represent foliage or an abstract environment.

artworks.title: The Charlatan (Le charlatan)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a city scene with a speaker addressing a crowd. There is a central figure standing on a platform speaking to a group of people. To the left, a large equestrian statue is visible. The crowd below is engaged in various activities. The architectural details of the wagon and buildings add depth to the scene. Cloud formations are depicted in the sky with fine lines. The drawing uses lines and cross-hatching for texture and dimension, conveying a dynamic urban life.

artworks.title: La Colère de Neptune (The Wrath of Neptune)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene. A central figure wields a spear, commanding or taming mythical sea creatures below. Two additional figures react to the central figure's actions. The central figure stands on a lavishly carved pedestal with intricate detailing, including swirling patterns. The drawing is executed in a detailed style typical of classical mythological depictions. The title "LA COLERE DE NEPTUNE" suggests the drawing is about Neptune, the Roman god of the sea, capturing energy and tumult. The composition is framed within a rectangular border.

artworks.title: Four Vases (Les quatres vases)
artworks.description: This is an image showing four sketches of ornate urn designs. Each sketch features a different decorative urn with intricate embellishments. The top left sketch depicts an urn with cherubic figures, the top right shows a vessel with draped figures, the bottom left displays an urn supported by lion-like creatures, and the bottom right features an urn with figures on its surface. The designs appear to blend sculptural elements, possibly indicative of baroque or rococo styles.

artworks.title: Allégorie des mariages faits par la ville de Paris à la naissance du duc de Bourgogne (Allegory of the Marriages Performed by the City of Paris in Honor of the Birth of the Duc de Bourgogne in 1751)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical scene depicting marriage. The artwork shows figures, predominantly cherubs and mythological beings, engaging in a celebration under a grand architectural structure with columns. The top portion includes cherubs holding an ornate oval frame and other cherubs in flight, while the central figures are reclining amidst flowing drapery. At the bottom, more cherubs and classical musical instruments are scattered, creating a sense of festivity. The use of line and form creates a theatrical atmosphere, highlighting the allegorical nature of marriages as a ceremonious event.

artworks.title: The Two Lovers (Les Deux amants)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in a natural setting. One person is kneeling and leaning towards the other, who is seated on a rock. The kneeling person has long, wavy hair and visible clothing details. The seated person has curly hair and is wearing a flowing garment. Flowers and a musical instrument are near their feet. The background consists of dense foliage, trees, and shrubbery.

artworks.title: On ne s'avise jamais de tout
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a courtyard scene with architectural elements and multiple figures engaged in various activities. The image depicts a scene with a tower on the left. The architecture is detailed and includes a turret with a pointed roof, as well as a prominent building façade with a dormer window and open shutters. In the foreground, a group of figures is gathered, with some appearing to engage in conversation or interaction near an open gate. The sky is mostly empty but for a few sparse lines. The figures' attire and architectural details suggest a historical or narrative scene.

artworks.title: Le Papillon et la Tortue (The Butterfly and the Turtle)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a butterfly-winged creature riding a turtle. The creature is perched atop the turtle, which appears to be moving. The creature holds a slender rope or rein. The scene is surrounded by a decorative border with intricate detailing.

artworks.title: A Bishop
artworks.description: The artwork shows a person standing upright. The individual has a youthful face with round features and short, curly hair under a tall mitre. They wear ecclesiastical robes with intricate details like a cross around the neck. They hold a crosier in the left hand and raise the right hand with two fingers extended. There is no visible jewelry. The background is a simple, unadorned surface resembling a wooden or tile floor, with a blank wall behind, emphasizing the figure.

artworks.title: The Flooded Seine in 1910 (La Seine en crue, en 1910)
artworks.description: The image shows a river scene with a bridge in the distance. There are trees along the riverbank, and a steamship with smoke rising into the sky is featured. The style of the image is impressionistic with stippled brushstrokes creating texture in the water and sky. The color palette includes shades of black, gray, and off-white. A small boat with figures inside is seen on the water, trees frame the left side, and buildings are hinted at in the cityscape on the horizon.

artworks.title: Allegory of the Emperor and the Pope
artworks.description: This is a drawing with a complex composition of symbolic elements. It features a large boat with architectural details and inscriptions. Two large figures are central, connected through ribbons with inscriptions like 'REX IMAPTORE.' Other labels include 'PAPA,' 'REX FRANCIE,' and 'DUX MEDIOLANI.' The scene includes a star labeled 'COMETA,' insignias, and a scale symbolizing justice. A blazing star on the right adds to the celestial theme. The style is intricate, resembling medieval or early Renaissance iconography, with allegorical content conveying a potential political or moral message.
